coverage: All ESCO skills linked to the pilot occupations
description: Skills related (essential or optional) to the pilot occupations in ESCO
processing_method: skill_name = ESCO preferredLabel; category by ESCO skill-hierarchy rules R1-R6 in priority order plus reviewed overrides (scripts/dataset/esco/category_overrides.csv); aliases = ESCO altLabels minus ambiguous ones (see datasets/processed/skill/dropped_aliases.csv).
notes: 754 aliases kept, 7 dropped. Technologies missing from ESCO (e.g. React, Node.js, Figma) are added in Phase 3.
